video_metadata.title: Markets Today: Why I'm Bullish on Tech and Bearish on Energy

input.transcript_snippet: Hey traders welcome back to Daily Market Take. Looking at the action today the S&P closed up about a percent, Nasdaq leading as usual, and energy was the laggard. I think we're in a continuation of the risk-on rotation that started last week. The Fed minutes leaned slightly dovish which is helping the long-duration trade, growth and tech catching a bid, financials kind of meh. Crude is struggling because the dollar is firming and we had a soft inventories print. So what does that mean? I think tech is going to keep grinding higher into FOMC. I'd be a buyer on dips. Energy I would not be touching, lots of supply overhang. The setup I like best right now is just being long quality tech and waiting out the noise. As always not financial advice, do your own research, see you tomorrow.
